name: Sika Injection-111
paste:
SIKA® INJECTION-111: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Injection-111, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika-injection-111.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Injection-111 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Injection-111 is a highly expansive hydrophobic MDI based urethane injection grout designed to be used with an accelerator. Sika® Injection-111 reacts when it comes into contact with water to create a hydrophobic foam.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Injection-111 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Stop active water flow
    - Stop water ingress into structures
    - Back grouting
    - Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork
    - Seal leaks in joints and cracks

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Injection-111
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Hydrophobic semi flexible polyurethane injection grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Environmentally friendly
    - Solvent and phthalate free
    - Reacts with fresh and sea water
    - Reaction time can be adjusted with catalyst
    - Suitable for hydrostatic pressure environments
    - Semi-flexible
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: MDI based urethane
    - Colour: brownish liquid
    - Density: 1.15-1.20 (g/cm3)
    - Viscosity: 160-170 mPa.s ( 21 °C)
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: > 150 °C
    - Expansion: Maximum 2500%; *This varies depending on amount of Sika® Injection 111C Catalyst used and temperatures
2.6 Compressive stiffness. Data based on 10% addition of Sika® Injection-111C (Catalyst)
    | Compression applied | Compression data (free rise) |
    | 2% | 8.5KPa |
    | 5% | 36KPa |
    | 10% | 67KPa |
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Sika® Injection-111- 20kg pail; Sika® Injection-111C- 2kg bottle (Catalyst)
    - Shelf life: 12 months
    - Storage conditions: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Mixing ratio. Sika® Injection-111 requires the catalyst Sika® Injection-111C to create a reactive foam for injection. Typical mix ratios vary from 2-10% of the Sika® Injection-111C depending on the reaction time required, please refer to the reaction table on this PDS for the information.
4.3 Reaction time. Reaction time at 5°C
    | Sika Injection-111C | Start time | End time |
    | (Catalyst) |
    | 2% addition | 1min | 5min 38 sec |
    | 6% addition | 30 sec | 3min 25 sec |
    | 10% addition | 23 sec | 2min 33 sec |
    | Reaction time at 15°C |
    | Sika Injection-111C | Start time | End time |
    | (Catalyst) |
    | 2% addition | 51 sec | 5min 6 sec |
    | 6% addition | 23 sec | 2min 54 sec |
    | 10% addition | 18 sec | 2min |
    | Reaction time at 25°C |
    | Sika Injection-111C | Start time | End time |
    | (Catalyst) |
    | 2% addition | 35 sec | 4min |
    | 6% addition | 18 sec | 2min 40 sec |
    | 10% addition | 16 sec | 1min 41 sec |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Equipment. Sika® Injection-111 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.
4.5 Mixing. Sika® Injection-111 should be mixed with Sika® Injection-111C using a paddle drill mixer to create a uniform homogeneous liquid for a minimum of 20-30 seconds.
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Injection-111, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika-injection-111.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika® Injection-111, version 20/07/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/Sika%C2%AE%20Injection-111.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
